By removing personally identifiable information (PII) and direct LLM outputs from raw telemetry traces, it ensures that the downstream Markov Decision Process (MDP) operates on sanitized state transitions. Mathematically, this is a projection onto a subspace that excludes sensitive dimensions, thereby satisfying differential privacy constraints. The resulting filtered traces can be used to train a policy network $\pi(a|s)$ without exposing user secrets, improving long-term autonomy and reducing reliance on expensive SaaS monitoring tools that require access to raw data.
